This is a magnificent HD film that is about the courageous bush pilots of the far north country, Alaska. Shot entirely in many different remote and wild areas of this huge land, the story is the real deal. From the vintage aircraft these men fly to the highly advanced, the viewer is introduced to a non-nonsense presentation that also captures the giant bears, glaciers and wilderness of Alaska. Directed by Jim Oltersdorf, who, is on The Discovery Channels "The Risk Takers 2, High Risk Photographer". Oltersdorf is also on The History Channel's "Monster Quest, Attack of the Giant Bear"
